recommendation: Keep this audit as the FHIR-core source reconciliation for FHIR-25262. Follow up separately on FHIR-57383 or Kindling/tooling if the generated Patient.id snapshot regression is accepted for correction.
issue_request: FHIR-25262 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction raised for R4 and applied for R5, asking that Resource.id-derived profile metadata use fhir-type id rather than string.
initial_application: No current commit explicitly names FHIR-25262. Source history shows the Resource definition moving through the R4B/R5 source rework, with commit 73080e5bdeff04df26787237e1412af2fc181915 normalizing the already-correct id value to valueUrl id; FHIR-25274 also records that the type error had already been corrected by another tracker.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Resource as active and normative, so source/resource/structuredefinition-Resource.xml is in build scope. ElementDefinition notes document the System.String plus fhir-type pattern, and later FHIR-45989 confirms Resource.id should remain System.String with FHIR id value constraints. Current generated Patient.id artifacts still show a string regression tracked by unresolved FHIR-57383, which appears to require Kindling/generated-snapshot work rather than a core source hunk for this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current Resource.id source already has the requested fhir-type valueUrl id, and no checked-in Patient profile source artifact exists to edit for the inherited generated-snapshot discrepancy.
